title: FedMAQ experiments: a federated-learning testbed with matched-budget byte accounting
description: Code, frozen configuration, and run machinery for evaluating memory-bounded adaptive quantization and ensemble distillation (FedMAQ) against FedAvg, FedPAQ, DAdaQuant, FedKD and other baselines in simulated federated learning on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and FEMNIST, with shared byte accounting across methods.
